text: Hi, I'm Bill Carter. I was wondering how much it costs to replace a whole bathroom's plumbing?
Our standard diagnostic visit fee is $89 to evaluate the job. Would you like to schedule a visit for one of our technicians to take a look and give you an estimate?
No, I just want a rough idea of the price. How much does something like that usually run?
We don't have a fixed price for full bathroom plumbing, so a technician would need to inspect it in person. Would you like to schedule an $89 diagnostic visit to get a detailed estimate?
Can't you just give me a ballpark figure? Surely you've done this before.

I'm unable to estimate complete bathroom replumbing over the phone because every project is unique. Would you like to book a technician visit so we can evaluate your bathroom and give you an exact quote?
No thanks, I'll look around. Goodbye.
Thanks for calling Lakeside Plumbing & Heating. Have a great day!
